disputes.issue: Book-imbalance sign flip on BTC: -0.6216 at 23:12:13 UTC versus +0.2906 at 23:53:57 UTC while price rose 80,457 -> 81,078 (+0.77%).
disputes.evidence: A 0.91-point swing in 42 minutes on the same instrument is either genuine bid absorption or a change in venue weighting/aggregation between snapshot generations. Until distinguished, a passive sell limit must not assume the asks are thin.

disputes.issue: Cross-asset conflict: BTC +0.29, ETH +0.86, SOL +0.30 and GOLD +0.51 book imbalance are all bid-heavy while weekly CVD is bearish on BTC (-142.9M) and SOL (-26.2M) and seller-aggressive on GOLD.
disputes.evidence: Either a broad bid-support regime (mean-reversion risk for short breakout plays) or a shared measurement artefact. Both readings argue against treating BTC and SOL shorts as independent tickets, so the 2-ticket scenario is joint-stressed to 4,807.57.
